title: Infinity Player PC v1.5.7
changelog: Real YouTube Music Integration: Connected directly to official YouTube Music (WEB_REMIX Innertube API). Dedicated navigation for Songs, Artists, Albums, Playlists, Trending Hits, and Charts. Pure music results with zero general video, movie, or web series clutter.

android.title: Infinity Player Android Beta 0.27.12
android.changelog: AudioVault web series episode navigation fix (pressing Back returns to series episode list instead of search); YouTube Favorites fix (saving to favorites keeps user on player screen instead of jumping to search); Real YouTube Music Integration (direct connection to YouTube Music Innertube API with Songs, Artists, Albums, Playlists, Trending Hits & Charts).
